'''Rhoda''' (Japanese: '''レース''' ''Res'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG141|Hail to the Chef!]]''. 

She is a restaurant manager who lives near [[Saffron City]]. After competing with her younger twin sister, {{OBP|Rhonda|AG141}}, for the inheritance of her father's restaurant, she decided to give it to her sister after seeing how she handled the situation when their Pokémon were taken by {{TRT}}. As she was leaving, her sister hired her as the restaurant's co-manager and her Sneasel as its head chef. After that, their Pokémon cooked delicious food together for {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}.
